title: The COVID lab-leak idea is just a conspiracy theory
short_summary: In early 2020 major journals, officials, and platforms treated the laboratory-origin hypothesis as a fringe conspiracy theory. Private contemporaneous records show leading scientists took laboratory scenarios seriously at the same time.
label: False
evidence_for: Very little primary scientific evidence in Feb–Mar 2020 forced the conclusion that lab origin was fringe.
evidence_against: WIV conducted bat SARS-related CoV research including genetic manipulation, with U.S. funding via EcoHealth.
Early private scientific discussion took lab scenarios seriously; Fauci’s diary confirms this.
U.S. IC never treated lab origin as fringe (ODNI 2021).
No definitive intermediate host identified despite years of searching.

title: NIH has not ever and does not now fund gain-of-function research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology
short_summary: Fauci and NIH stated NIH never funded GOF at WIV. Contested: narrow regulatory definition vs ordinary scientific usage; chimeric work under EcoHealth subawards is documented.
label: Contested
evidence_for: NIH applied a specific regulatory definition tied to the 2014–2017 pause and later P3CO framework.
Studied bat SARSr-CoVs are genetically distant from SARS-CoV-2.
evidence_against: Documented chimeric coronavirus construction under EcoHealth → WIV subawards.
Ordinary scientific usage of GOF covers enhancement of human-cell infectivity.
HHS later suspended and debarred EcoHealth for compliance failures around this work.
2018 DEFUSE proposal from the same network proposed further enhancement work.

title: The Lancet Letter (19 February 2020)
short_summary: Organized by Peter Daszak; 27 signatories. Condemned non-natural-origin claims as conspiracy theories. Published after private calls that took lab scenarios seriously. Competing-interest addendum 2021.
label: True

title: The Proximal Origin of SARS-CoV-2 (Nature Medicine, 17 March 2020)
short_summary: Andersen et al. concluded SARS-CoV-2 is not a laboratory construct. Drafting overlapped private Jan–Feb calls and the Lancet letter; FOIA/Slack show non-trivial lab-origin probabilities during drafting.
label: True
